title: Defer Until Active Branch Lands
purpose: Validate that a useful but non-urgent requirement is captured as deferred work instead of interrupting active implementation.
expectedFinalIntent: Preserve the future notification digest idea as deferred roadmap work while keeping the active approval-grant branch unchanged.

userFragments.content: After approval grants work, maybe Secretary should send me a daily digest of what it approved.
Do not interrupt the grant pipeline right now.
Just make sure this is remembered and reviewed after the active branch lands.

secretaryReplies.content: This is a future reporting capability related to approval grants, not part of the active grant pipeline implementation.
The control record should mark this as deferred and avoid steering the current branch.
The next step is to link the deferred idea to the approval-grant capability and revisit it after the active branch lands.

review after the active branch lands
